## Download

multiclaude runs on **macOS only** (it reads Claude Code logins from the macOS Keychain). There are no Linux or Windows builds.

| Mac | Archive |
|---|---|
| Apple silicon (M1 and later) | `ccm_darwin_arm64.tar.gz` |
| Intel | `ccm_darwin_amd64.tar.gz` |

Install with one command:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pratikbhadane24/multiclaude/main/install.sh | sh
```

Or download an archive below, unpack it somewhere permanent and run `./ccm install`. Verify downloads against `checksums.txt`. Details: [docs/install.md](https://github.com/pratikbhadane24/multiclaude/blob/main/docs/install.md).
